visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair and a white t-shirt sits at a light-grained wooden table, resting his chin on his left hand and looking towards the camera. The background consists of vertical grey pleated curtains. (2) A woman in a white collared shirt enters from the left, placing several folders (black, blue, green) and a photograph of a car onto the table while engaging in conversation. (3) The man examines the documents inside the folders; his facial expressions shift from curiosity to surprise, gesturing with his hands as the woman presents various colored folders. (4) The setting transitions to a bedroom with soft lighting; the man is lying in bed under a blue and white floral patterned blanket. (5) He sits up abruptly with an exaggerated wide-mouthed expression of excitement, after which the woman lying next to him repeatedly slaps his face with her palm. (6) The man remains in bed, looking bewildered and touching his cheek where he was hit, while the woman rolls over and continues to speak. (7) The video concludes with several blooper segments (NG clips) showing the same bedroom scene with the actors laughing and reacting to failed takes.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice asking a question in a moderate tone over a quiet room background. (2) A female voice enters with a casual, explanatory tone; a sharp thudding sound occurs as a folder is placed on a hard surface. (3) Continuous rustling of paper and plastic files is heard as the two characters engage in rapid-fire dialogue. (4) A sentimental, slow-tempo piano melody fades in, accompanying a shift in the male's voice to a more emotional and confused pitch. (5) A sudden, high-intensity vocal scream '想要!' (I want it!) pierces the track, followed immediately by four rapid, percussive hitting sounds (slaps). (6) A comedic 'boing' sound effect signals a transition; the female voice becomes scolding while the male voice sounds groggy and muffled. (7) A deep bassy chime/gong sound follows a pause. (8) The final segment features multiple takes of the hitting sound and voices breaking into high-pitched laughter, indicating an outtake reel.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Circular: Setup -> Climax -> Twist -> Loop back to bloopers
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create humor through the subversion of expectations, contrasting a 'dream' scenario of sudden wealth and spousal generosity with the harsh, comedic reality of being slapped awake for sleep-talking.
